description: A local app that rents a GPU in your own Colab account and serves Qwen3.8 on it: 27B on an A100-40G, or Flash-Next (125B-A6B MoE) on an A100-80G. The cost is shown before it starts; chat with images; Codex or any OpenAI client uses a fixed local /v1. Auto-stop, CU ledger, live prefill/decode. Windows, macOS, Linux.
